name: Precious Stones
overview: Scripture reveals precious stones as significant elements in God's covenantal relationship with Israel, symbolizing both remembrance and divine presence. The onyx stones engraved with the names of the children of Israel and set upon the high priest's ephod represent a memorial before the LORD, emphasizing the priest's role in bearing the people before God (Exodus 28:9-12). Additionally, the breastplate of judgment adorned with carefully set stones, including sardius, topaz, and carbuncle, reflects the meticulous craftsmanship and sacred symbolism entrusted to Israel's leaders (Exodus 25:7; 28:17). These stones also illustrate the beauty and stability associated with God's dwelling and governance, as seen in the sapphire stone beneath God's feet, likened to the clearness of the heavens (Exodus 24:10).
